rust_summary: an entity turned without moving it, as `/rotate` does, a mob's head apart (`native_set_entity_rotation`).
doc_summary: `native_set_entity_rotation(dimension, id, yaw, pitch, head_yaw)`, an entity of any loaded level turned without moving it as `/rotate` does (`Entity.forceSetRotation`), with `head_yaw` turning a mob's head alone (`setYHeadRot`): mobs, mannequins, armor stands, boats, minecarts, fangs and displays. Bundles need "hooks": @API:npc_entity_rotation@.
